full15.server_stop_semantics: Serving processes were stopped by their owned phase cleanup; all15 controller outcomes are zero. Absence of OOM/timeout is based on saved outcomes and journals, not a new hardware run.

measurement_semantics: Aggregate throughput is completion-token sum / full HTTP client group elapsed, including executor/barrier/client/server/sampler overhead; model startup, compilation and the8-token warmup precede measured groups.
Each nonmixed workload has3 single and3 concurrent groups plus one4-request streaming observation. Streaming observation is outside the reported3-round throughput medians.

Mixed has16 streaming requests per round and4 client workers. Per-request latency excludes waiting in the client worker queue; aggregate elapsed includes all work. p95 is nearest rank; TTFT measures first nonempty decoded-text chunk.

Throughput ratios are candidate median throughput / reference median throughput. Group-elapsed ratio is reference median group elapsed / candidate median group elapsed. Fixed equal token totals make these ratios agree here.
Reference suite ran before candidate suite; no randomized/crossover ordering or significance claim.

Route observation computes/asserts signatures each call and writes only first-seen signatures; same wrapper on both sides. Storage polling every5s spans both workloads. No profiler ran inside this audit; observer overhead is present and not separately quantified.

Owned-heavy-unit exclusion and process/cgroup guards provide recorded isolation; saved evidence does not continuously enumerate every unrelated host process or provide CPU-frequency/throttling history.

stochastic_workloads.scope: Equal prompt and forced-token budgets, not stochastic text equality or identical random-number streams.

memory.measurement: Idle post-workload neuron-monitor snapshot; helper note says after quality checks but source calls capture after workload evaluation.

material_caveat.finding: Inherited long result field original_full_causal_reference_crosscheck_passed=true is hardcoded and is not accepted as evidence.
material_caveat.interpretation: Long qualification uses selected exact native cached-HF trajectories. The original full-causal/natural-reference failure remains; two position510 rows exceeded the original gates. Frozen result is retained unchanged.

claim_decisions.meaning: Fresh packaged reference and NKI artifacts pass original32 full-vocabulary, cold84 and selected cached-HF long1529/84 gates; quality96 has no individual lost-correct cases; original smoke, initial120 and matched5x3 workloads complete; all76 designated greedy text+usage comparisons equal.
claim_decisions.bounded_speedup_claim: On the recorded Trn1 BF16 TP2 B4 context2048/minimum-decode2048 standard-CPU-sampler matched pair, NKI candidate median HTTP throughput is7.1278–8.1571x reference for four single workloads,5.3136–8.0474x for their concurrent workloads, and5.4986x for mixed_lengths. Three sequential rounds per workload; no statistical-significance or broader deployment claim.
claim_decisions.prefix_note: Serving explicitly disables prefix caching; cold prefix-length experiments do not qualify prefix caching.
claim_decisions.production_branch_documentation: May document these exact bounded results and immutable evidence; this audit does not publish, merge, promote or certify production readiness.
claim_decisions.worse_same_mixed_policy: Use only original protocol gates: qualification and speed are separate. Worse yields no speedup, equal yields no observed gain, mixed requires workload-specific wins/regressions. No arbitrary new acceptance thresholds or aggregate.

followup_optimization_evidence_if_needed: For a slower future NKI candidate, tie profiles to exact artifacts and quantify read/write time, launch/synchronization, transfers/copies and fallback coverage under the same workloads.

Separate cold startup from steady HTTP serving, estimate the fraction of end-to-end time affected, then rerun the original gates and matched comparison on fresh artifacts. These are follow-up evidence needs, not new gates.
